info.title: Geren.Server.Exporter
info.description: Exports a custom JSON specification from ASP.NET Core Minimal API endpoints

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Exclude endpoints matching rule (repeatable).
Rule examples:
path:/stat/*
route:re:^/v[0-9]+/
namespace:MyCompany.MyApi.*
Notes:
- Rules are OR-ed within include/exclude lists.
- If any include rules exist, only matching endpoints are kept.
- Exclude rules always win.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help
Exit codes:
0   Success (or --help)
1   Unexpected error
2   Invalid arguments / usage
3   Failed to create Compilation
4   Canceled
